confirmed_findings.title: Authority-required GC error becomes a post-publication build failure
confirmed_findings.trigger: A normal source change leaves a formerly referenced valid key outside the new manifest.
confirmed_findings.trace: delete_key now always returns authority-required for valid keys; existing garbage_collect_artifacts propagates it at materialization.rs:1197-1199; Direct/Managed post-publication callers propagate at 1016-1023 and 1070.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Existing artifact_gc_retains_active_manifest_keys_and_removes_stale_keys fails in isolated frozen copy with the authority-required error; the call trace establishes post-publication consequence. The old deletion assertion itself is superseded by guarded GC.
confirmed_findings.remedy: Keep deletion fail-closed. Route these cleanup outcomes to separate pending reporting without failing a completed publication or masking the primary result. Coordinate the S4 caller change before integrated readiness.
confirmed_findings.regression: Exercise two real source revisions: second publication succeeds, active queries/cache survive, and cleanup pending is reported while the reference seal is unavailable.

confirmed_findings.title: A torn progress marker blocks replay permanently
confirmed_findings.trigger: Process death/write failure after create_new_file(.unlinked) succeeds but before complete marker content is written, after payload unlink has synced.
confirmed_findings.trace: Final .unlinked name is visible before contents are complete. Subsequent read_unlinked_stage parses the empty/partial marker at935 and returns an error. Retry never rewrites or atomically replaces it.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Exact on-disk crash-state probes with empty and one-byte markers, then two retries under freshly acquired leases, consistently return EOF and leave private directory, stage and journal.
confirmed_findings.remedy: Publish progress atomically from a fully synced temporary, or use another recoverable bounded transition that distinguishes interrupted own writes from foreign state. Preserve unknown files.
confirmed_findings.regression: Fault each progress create/write/fsync/publish boundary, restart/reacquire, and verify eventual cleanup plus preservation of newly introduced foreign payloads.

confirmed_findings.title: The new validation memory limit does not bound retained decoded state
confirmed_findings.trigger: A valid artifact includes a metadata array with many small JSON values.
confirmed_findings.trace: Admission uses 2*file_bytes+64KiB; serde Value/Vec allocation can exceed that estimate, before row-validation index allocations. New retained maintenance jobs reuse the pre-existing loader heuristic.

evidence.result: Maintenance validation succeeds, although one field alone exceeds the supplied ceiling.

confirmed_findings.remedy: Use enforced decoding/accounting limits or a justified conservative structural bound, including temporary validation indices and concurrent retained jobs. Do not infer a memory ceiling from encoded bytes alone.
confirmed_findings.regression: Admit/reject dense small JSON values, large maps, partial parses, and concurrent retained jobs against the actual configured total budget.

confirmed_findings.title: Marker housekeeping bypasses the work allowance
confirmed_findings.trigger: Replay an empty detached artifact with zero entries or zero duration.
confirmed_findings.trace: The payload branch and its budget take are skipped. Marker create/write/fsync occurs before the first take at887. remove_retirement_journal also unlinks both stage and journal under one allowance.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Executed zero-entry and zero-duration probes both create .unlinked. Separate probe confirms one final allowance removes both journal entries.
confirmed_findings.remedy: Check/reserve allowance before every independent housekeeping mutation and preserve a resumable boundary; define/charge bounded atomic bookkeeping explicitly. Zero allowance should make no filesystem mutation.
confirmed_findings.regression: Snapshot tree/metadata around max_entries=0 and max_duration=ZERO; verify no mutation. Verify the declared one-entry unlink bound including auxiliary records.

conditional_limits: Gated reads/writes, hashing and manual row comparisons cooperate, but ordinary serde BTreeMap<String,...> insertion/comparison and decoded-value disposal do not consult the gate. AdvisoryArtifactJob::Drop synchronously joins; cancellation can therefore wait for those CPU/disposal atoms. No measured 100ms miss is claimed. Constrain largest atoms/resource caps or keep joining/reclamation off the foreground path before enabling the controller.
